Renault Triber Turbo and Duster Hybrid Launch Details Emerge

Information regarding upcoming Renault models, the Triber Turbo and Duster Hybrid, has been released. The Renault Triber Turbo will feature a turbo petrol engine, offering more power than the regular petrol model, and is positioned as a performance-oriented 7-seater car at a competitive price. The Renault Duster Hybrid's launch date has been confirmed, with details on its engine, battery, and features expected.
